task.description: GH #566 / ISS-0617: TC-EXP-601-01 ('quota policy resolves the effective profile from the active config surface') asserts the resolved profile's max_entity_records_total is 10 (a deliberately small test override) but gets 200000 (the evident platform default) instead. TC-EXP-601-02, 03, 04 (quota middleware rejection tests for entity/file/sandbox-allocation writes) fail downstream of the same misresolved profile. Not yet root-caused -- genuinely new, no SQL error correlates with this test's timestamp window (pure application-logic mismatch, not a query failure). Read tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig (all 4 test blocks) and find the tier-profile/quota resolution code (search src/ for 'tier_profile', 'quota', 'max_entity_records_total', or similar) in full. Trace the actual resolution path from config source to the resolver's return value -- determine whether this is a lookup-key mismatch (e.g. wrong tenant_id used), a missing seed row in the test fixture, or a config-precedence bug. Actually run the failing test to observe the failure directly (not just read code) -- export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test and BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5452/bpm_dev (workspace r-co-2's port band, already healthy), check build.zig for a scoped step (search 'exp601'), add temporary debug output if needed to trace runtime behavior, then revert any temporary debug code before finishing.
acceptance_criteria: The tier-profile override resolution path traced from config source to the resolver return value, with file:line precision
Root cause identified as lookup-key mismatch, missing seed data, or precedence bug -- confirmed via an actual test run, not just code reading
All 4 test blocks (TC-EXP-601-01 through 04) understood as either sharing this root cause or having distinct causes
